units.sourceHTML: 9.1 Specifying diff Options to sdiff

units.text: The following ⟦0⟧ options have the same meaning as for ⟦1⟧. See ⟦2⟧Options to ⟦3⟧⟦4⟧, for the use of these options.
units.sourceHTML: The following sdiff options have the same meaning as for diff. See Options to diff, for the use of these options.

units.text: For historical reasons, ⟦0⟧ has alternate names for some options. The ⟦1⟧ option is equivalent to the ⟦2⟧ option, and similarly ⟦3⟧ is equivalent to ⟦4⟧. The meaning of the ⟦5⟧ ⟦6⟧ and ⟦7⟧ options is interchanged from that of ⟦8⟧: with ⟦9⟧, ⟦10⟧ is equivalent to ⟦11⟧, and ⟦12⟧ is equivalent to ⟦13⟧. ⟦14⟧ without the ⟦15⟧ option is equivalent to ⟦16⟧ with the ⟦17⟧ (⟦18⟧) option (see ⟦19⟧Showing Differences Side by Side⟦20⟧).
units.sourceHTML: For historical reasons, sdiff has alternate names for some options. The -l option is equivalent to the --left-column option, and similarly -s is equivalent to --suppress-common-lines. The meaning of the sdiff -w and -W options is interchanged from that of diff: with sdiff, -w columns is equivalent to --width=columns, and -W is equivalent to --ignore-all-space. sdiff without the -o option is equivalent to diff with the --side-by-side (-y) option (see Showing Differences Side by Side).

nonProse: Command/flag literals and pure code/output examples retained; explanatory dt labels and italic pre descriptions extracted too; no unhandled prose text.
